Elaborar relatórios executivos, dashboards e indicadores detalhados sobre desempenho da frota, consumo energético, emissões e resultados dos projetos implementados;
Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas internas (Operação, Engenharia, Suprimentos e Financeiro), apoiando decisões relacionadas à estratégia de sustentabilidade da frota.
Apoiar processos de especificação técnica de veículos sustentáveis e novas tecnologias aplicáveis à operação rodoviária;
O que esperamos de você:
✅ Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Automotiva, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;

✅ Vivência em elaboração de business cases e apresentação de projetos para níveis gerenciais.

✅ Especialização em gestão de frotas;
✅ Vivência em projetos de eletrificação de frotas ou integração de combustíveis renováveis;
✅ Conhecimento em regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor de transportes e mobilidade;

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

title: Engenheiros de ia
description:
Job Description
A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.
Duties and Responsibilities:
• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.
• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.
• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.
• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.
• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.
Minimum Qualifications/Experience:
• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.
• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como Lang Graph, Pydantic AI, Llama Index, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.
• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, Chroma DB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.
• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.
• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.
• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.
Minimum Education:
Ensino superior completo.
Inglês Fluente

title: Comprador
description:
Sobre a Empresa A EPR é uma plataforma de investimentos em concessões de rodovias e mobilidade.
Nosso propósito é prestação de serviços de excelência aos usuários, administração e realização de investimentos consistentes para modernização e manutenção das rodovias concedidas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento sustentável das regiões que atuamos.
A empresa é a consolidação da parceria da Equipav, com mais de 60 anos de experiência em infraestrutura, com a Perfin, gestora de fundos de investimentos em infraestrutura.
Administramos sete concessões de rodovias no Estado de Minas Gerais e Paraná. A EPR Triângulo, a EPR Sul de Minas, a EPR Vias do Café e a EPR Via Mineira operam no estado mineiro e a EPR Litoral Pioneira, EPR Paraná e EPR Iguaçu em rodovias paranaenses.
Sobre o Papel A função principal é executar processos de compras de menor e média complexidade, conforme políticas e alçadas estabelecidas.

Responsabilidades
Executar processos de compras de menor e média complexidade, incluindo solicitação de cotações, análise comparativa de propostas, negociação básica, emissão de pedidos e acompanhamento do fornecimento.
Apoiar a seleção, homologação e acompanhamento de fornecedores, garantindo o atendimento às necessidades dos clientes internos.
Apoiar o planejamento das compras das categorias sob sua responsabilidade, em conjunto com as áreas solicitantes, conforme orientações da liderança.
Participar de projetos e iniciativas da área de Suprimentos, apoiando atividades de controle, organização de informações, prazos e documentação.
Apoiar a execução das estratégias de negociação definidas pela liderança ou compradores mais experientes.
Acompanhar o mercado fornecedor, realizando pesquisas de preços, análise básica de tendências e identificação de novos fornecedores.
Contribuir para a padronização e melhoria dos processos da área de Suprimentos, seguindo metodologias, procedimentos e boas práticas estabelecidas.
Apoiar o controle da demanda e do orçamento das unidades de negócio, realizando lançamentos, acompanhamentos e relatórios básicos.
Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente, Segurança do Trabalho e Responsabilidade Social, bem como dos requisitos regulamentares, estatutários, contratuais e dos clientes.

Bachelor's Degree

Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills

title: Facility manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.
Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:
Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.
IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.
Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.
Our Core Focuses:
End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.
Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.
Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.
We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.
Job Responsibilities:
1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).
2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.
3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.
4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.
5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.
6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.
7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.
Job Requirements:
1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.
2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.
3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.
4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.
5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.
6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.
7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.
8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.
9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. title: Process engineer
description:
About Us
We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems

reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are 
driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.
Role Summary
The Process Engineer is responsible for designing, optimizing, and implementing efficient industrial processes
while maintaining close collaboration with clients. This role acts as a key technical liaison, translating client 
requirements into practical, compliant, and cost-effective process solutions. The Process Engineer works directly 
with customers throughout the project lifecycle—requirements gathering, process definition, implementation, 
validation, and continuous improvement—ensuring technical excellence and high levels of client satisfaction.
In addition to process design and optimization, the role involves leading technical discussions, supporting 
decision-making with data-driven insights, managing change requests, and addressing client concerns in a 
proactive and solutions-oriented manner. Strong communication skills, customer focus, and the ability to align 
engineering solutions with business needs are essential for success in this position.
Essential Responsibilities
﻿• Manage and assess process changes requested by clients, ensuring feasibility, compliance, and risk
mitigation
• Prepare and maintain process documentation, including flow diagrams, SOPs, work instructions, and
reports
• Ensure processes comply with regulatory, safety, and quality standards applicable to the industry
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, quality, engineering, sales, and project management)
• Provide technical support during audits, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
• Monitor process performance using KPIs and recommend continuous improvement actions
• Support cost estimation, timelines, and technical inputs for proposals and project planning
• Build long-term client relationships through technical credibility, responsiveness, and solution-oriented
communication
• Act as the primary technical point of contact between the company and clients for process-related matters
• Gather, analyze, and translate client requirements into detailed process specifications and technical
solutions
• Design, develop, and optimize processes to improve efficiency, quality, safety, and cost-effectiveness
• Lead technical meetings, workshops, and presentations with clients to align expectations and communicate
progress
• Support process implementation, commissioning, and validation at client sites or remotely
• Identify process improvement opportunities and propose data-driven, innovative solutions
Qualifications/Requirements English – Conversation level Bachelor’s degree in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical
Engineering, or a related field
Strong knowledge of process design, process mapping, and optimization methodologies
Experience working in the mining industry
Hands-on experience with process implementation, troubleshooting, and performance improvement
Spanish is a diferential.

title: Bolsista doutor - linea brasil - linea inova | doutores inovando no setor empresarial - iel/pr
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.
O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.
Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .
Sobre a Oportunidade:
Venha impulsionar a inovação na indústria moveleira!
A Linea Brasil está iniciando um projeto estratégico para elevar sua eficiência, ampliar a capacidade produtiva e fortalecer sua competitividade no mercado. Para isso, buscamos a expertise de um doutor especializado, capaz de aplicar conhecimento científico avançado e transformar dados, processos e operações em soluções de alto impacto.
A proposta é mapear, modelar e otimizar processos, impulsionando a inovação e a melhoria contínua para levar a empresa a um novo patamar operacional.
Se você gosta de desafios reais, de gerar impacto direto na performance industrial e de contribuir para a evolução rumo à manufatura de classe mundial, esta é a oportunidade ideal para transformar a indústria com a gente!
Formação Acadêmica:
Engenharia de produção, industrial, mecânica, manufatura ou processos e afins.
Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.
Projeto: Impulsionar a inovação e a eficiência, aprimorando o foco no cliente, reduzindo custos e ampliando a escala produtiva moveleira.

Principais Atividades:
Diagnóstico e análise dos processos produtivos;
Modelagem, simulação e avaliação de cenários;
Desenvolvimento e teste de soluções inovadoras;
Escalonamento e padronização das melhorias;
Fortalecimento do foco no cliente;
Consolidação, documentação e transferência de conhecimento.
Conhecimento necessário:
Modelagem e análise de processos produtivos (VSM, balanceamento de linha, análise de gargalos)
Simulação e avaliação de cenários industriais
Aplicação de metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean Manufacturing, PDCA, Kaizen)
Análise estatística aplicada à otimização de processos
Dimensionamento e estudo de capacidade produtiva
Definição e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho (OEE, lead time, eficiência, produtividade)
Planejamento e condução de projetos de melhoria industrial
Conhecimento desejável:
Conhecimentos em Ciência de Dados e Analytics (Python, R, estatística avançada, algoritmos de otimização)
Engenharia de Layout e reestruturação fabril (projetos de plantas, estudos de fluxo físico tridimensional)
Gestão da experiência do cliente aplicada ao pós-venda (NPS, correlação com desempenho operacional, qualidade percebida)
WCM – World Class Manufacturing (pilares de FI, AM, EEM, logística, qualidade e E& D)
Manufatura enxuta aplicada à logística e embalagens
Conhecimentos em automação e integração de sistemas produtivos
Ferramentas de qualidade avançada (FMEA, DOE, QFD, análise multivariada)
Vivência em projetos industriais de grande porte ou escalabilidade
Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial
Formato de trabalho : Presencial
Local: Arapongas– PR
Soft Skills: Liderança; Trabalho em Equipe; Pensamento Crítico; Criatividade; Ética e responsabilidade.

Royal Enfield - About Us:
The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling .
Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.
Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.
A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.
Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH. NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

organizacionais.

profissionais.

e desenvolvimento de habilidades.

Definir estratégias de Gestão e moldar a direção técnica.
Resolver desafios complexos e inovadores.

Fomentar a disseminação de uma cultura organizacional que valorize a utilização eficaz de dados na

do setor

horas

Contribuição para políticas de remuneração, benefícios, reconhecimento, incentivos, feedback e
mentorias
Participação no desenvolvimento de planos de carreira, treinamento e desenvolvimento individual
Abertura, acompanhamento e finalização de chamados de TI
Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática,

Inglês intermediário (desejável avançado para leitura)

Experiência em gestão de orçamento para alocar recursos de maneira eficiente.
Visão estratégica de negócios e do time de dados.
Experiência em gestão de projetos de dados
Conhecimentos Técnicos:

Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): Expertise em ferramentas de Ia C como Terraform, Pulumi e
Cloud Formation.
Plataformas de Dados: Expertise em Databricks, incluindo gerenciamento e otimização de clusters.
Computação em Nuvem: Experiência avançada com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda,
RDS, EMR, Glue, Athena e Sage Maker. Conhecimento em GCP e Azure é um diferencial.
Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC, entendo os tradeoffs entre as
diferentes ferramentas e quando faz sentido usar cada.

lakehouse, incluindo Delta Lake e a estrutura Medallion.
Deploy de Modelos de Machine Learning: Experiência avançada no deploy e monitoramento de
modelos de machine learning.
Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Expertise com Apache Airflow, dbt, e outras ferramentas de ETL.
Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL.

controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).
Governança de Dados: Expertise em políticas de governança de dados, incluindo a gestão de dados
sensíveis e privados, conformidade com regulamentos (ex: LGPD), e uso de catálogos de dados para
garantir a acessibilidade e qualidade dos dados.

Collaborate with developers to understand requirements, ensure alignment with the development process, and support successful deployment
Continuously improve deployment processes through automation, identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains
Provide support to customers and end-users as needed, including troubleshooting and resolving issues related to deployed applications
Work with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and timely deployment of software applications
Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for our platform
Have the ability and flexibility to work with teams globally, across time zones
What you’ll have

5+ years of experience in a deployment role and a Masters Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management OR 7+ years of experience in a deployment role with a Bachelor’s degree.
Certification in any of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP or K8
Experience deploying and maintaining applications in any one of the clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience with cloud-based environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience with Dockers or similar and experience with Kubernetes or similar
Strong technical skills in automation, continuous integration, and deployment practices
Working knowledge with Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, etc.
Administration of databases (MS SQL, Mongo)
Working knowledge with Linux and Windows operating systems
What We Offer

Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.
How the process works

Apply – Submit your application by clicking the below.
Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
Online Assessment – (If Applicable)
During the interview phase, you will meet with the technical panel for 60 minutes. We will contact you after the interview to let you know if we’d like to progress your application.
Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.
More about us…
At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.
With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.
o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Analista de gente e performance pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Lead engineer (java)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :
Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our i Gaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Where you Fit In:
As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.
The impact you will have:
Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)
Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.
Technical leadership in partnership
Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.
Transactional systems & data engineering
Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.
Mentorship & team enablement
Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.
Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)
Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).
What we’re looking for:
We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.
Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
Advanced English.
Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.
This role is Remote based in Brazil.

Working with cross functional teams to develop and grow the sales pipeline and consistently meet the revenue targets, thereby maintaining healthy metrics and KPIs.

What we look for?
At least 2 years of experience in phone-based, outbound B2 B sales development / inside sales role. Excellent proficiency in English communication, both written & verbal.

Positive speaking skills, strong listening skills, writing skills
Have the grit to handle rejections efficiently.
Good understanding of running and executing email drip campaigns.
Proven ability to undertake in-depth online research, and via social media.
Ability to work and easily adapt to an ever-changing fast-paced environment.
Most importantly, you should have long-term plans to pursue a career in Sales or Sales Development.
Why Netcore?
Being first is in our nature. The first and leading AI/ML-powered marketing automation enabling better customer engagements for businesses of all sizes with cutting-edge technologies that include AI, automation, top-notch product experience, customer data platform, communication API, and multi-channel client engagement options, - a comprehensive customer experience platform to enhance and exhilarate the client journey.
Netcore has a perfect combo of experience as well as an agile mind. We are currently serving more than 70% of B2 C Unicorns in India and 5000+ brands across 18 countries, making us among the top-rated marketing automation suite for enterprises.
Headquartered in Mumbai, we have our global footprints across 10 countries worldwide. Being certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years only reinforces Netcore’s principle of being a people-centric company – where you will not be just an employee but a family member of the organization.
A career at Netcore is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to shape the future. For more information, please visit netcorecloud.com or follow us on Linked In.
What’s in it for you?

Immense growth, continuous learning and connect with the top-notch brands
Work with some of the most innovative brains

Open culture where your creative bug gets activated
Opportunity to pitch multiple products

Revisão das informações coletadas em campo;

Verificação de formulários e validação dos dados coletados em campo.

Disponibilidade total de horários (inclusive aos finais de semana);

title: Sales representative- talent pipeline
description:
Note: We’re proactively identifying strong profiles for future openings. This position is not immediately available.

With teams across the world — from Paris to Melbourne, Dubai to São Paulo, Casablanca to Kuala Lumpur — we are building a future where IT is greener, smarter, and more sustainable. How does that sound to you?

Have a Leadership skills to coach, guide, and inspire junior team members.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.

Responsibilities
Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.

Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.
Must have skills
7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
Apache Kafka.
AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.
Nice to have skills
Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).
Conditions
Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
BYOD required (bring your own device).

Sobre a vaga

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).
Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Aws platform engineer
description:
About You
You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.
You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.
This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
Proven experience using Git Hub and Git Hub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
Collaborate with engineering and Dev Ops teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.
Qualifications
6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
Conversational English (B2+).
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

O que buscamos num profissional?
Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.
A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.
Sobre a Tereos
Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.
Tereos no Brasil
A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Master data modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location
Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM Info Sphere Data Architect, SAP Power Designer, or similar tools.
Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or My SQL.
Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Coordenador de manutenÇÃo regional
description:
Garantir suporte técnico, padronização, governança e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção das unidades operacionais da região, assegurando aderência aos padrões HARSCO aumentando a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.
DESAFIOS DO CARGO
Elevar a maturidade dos processos de manutenção dos sites.
Garantir aplicação consistente dos planos de manutenção corporativos.
Aumentar confiabilidade dos ativos por meio de análise técnica e disciplina operacional.
Atuar como elo técnico entre operação, engenharia, suprimentos e fornecedores.
Suportar decisões de CAPEX, especificações técnicas, RFQ e estratégias de reforma.
Desenvolver tecnicamente supervisores e planejadores dos sites.

ATIVIDADES
1. Suporte Técnico Regional
Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico aos supervisores e gerentes de manutenção dos sites.
Revisar e orientar diagnósticos de falhas críticas (RCFA / 5 Porquês / Ishikawa).
Apoiar decisões de “retirar ou manter máquina”, garantindo segurança e confiabilidade
2. Governança e Padronização:
Garantir que todos os sites executem o plano de manutenção corporativo revisado.
Validar cumprimento de preventivas, preditivas das unidades.
Aplicar auditorias técnicas periódicas de manutenção.
Acompanhar indicadores regionais: Disponibilidade, Confiabilidade, MTBF, MTTR, backlog, Service Accuracy, Aderência Programação etc.
3. Suporte ao Planejamento & PCM dos Sites
Orientar o PCM dos sites quanto à priorização de backlog, sequência PM, peças críticas e otimização de estoques.
Monitorar performance das execuções PM e corretivas.
4. Especificações, Engenharia de Manutenção e CAPEX
Participar tecnicamente de RFQs de equipamentos.
Auxiliar na elaboração de escopo para CAPEX e reformas estruturais.
Avaliar tecnicamente equipamentos usados para aquisição.
Liderar as grandes reformas de máquinas móveis pesadas.
5. Relação com Fornecedores & Qualidade Técnica
Avaliar e homologar fornecedores regionais de manutenção, reforma e peças.
Cobrar performance técnica de fornecedores (qualidade de reparo, garantia, lead time).
Realizar visitas técnicas para inspeção e auditoria em oficinas externas
6. Relatórios e Gestão de Resultados Regionais
Consolidar, analisar e reportar indicadores técnicos regionais ao gerente regional.
Gerar relatórios de conformidade, ações corretivas, riscos e recomendações executivas.
Contribuir para fóruns de governança de ativos e comitês regionais de manutenção.
7. Outras Atividades de Suporte
Apoiar comissionamento de novos equipamentos.
Avaliar e sugerir melhorias na infraestrutura de oficinas dos sites.
Participar de investigações de incidentes envolvendo equipamentos.
CONHECIMENTOS GERAIS
Formação Mínima:
Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Produção, Mecatrônica ou Elétrica
Formação Ideal
Superior completo em Engenharia com especialização em engenharia de manutenção ou confiabilidade.
Experiência
3–5 anos em manutenção de equipamentos móveis pesados (carregadeiras, caminhões fora de estrada, escavadeiras, MH).
Experiência prévia como supervisor de engenharia/PCM ou engenheiro de manutenção.

title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:
About You
You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.
Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Analista de gerenciamento de risco pleno
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital. Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala;1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente;23.000 pontos de distribuição;400.000 colaboradores; Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!
Posição: Analista de Gerenciamento de Risco Pleno
Descrição da posição:
Gestão de Riscos: Atuação como facilitador entre transportadoras, gerenciadoras de riscos (GR) e seguradoras para mitigar perdas e otimizar processos logísticos.
Regulação de Sinistros: Análise técnica de processos de roubo e avaria, garantindo a conformidade com as apólices de seguro e liquidação junto às seguradoras.
Inteligência de Dados: Monitoramento de KPIs de segurança e criação de dashboards de sinistralidade para suporte à decisão.
Auditoria de Processos: Verificação da performance de GRs e garantia de aderência total ao Plano de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR).
Mediação de Conflitos: Alinhamento operacional entre a operação (ponta) e a estratégia (seguradora/cliente).
Treinamento e Capacitação: Desenvolvimento de programas de treinamento para transportadoras e motoristas sobre normas de segurança e protocolos de contingência.
Cultura de Prevenção: Promoção ativa de diretrizes de segurança e prevenção de riscos em toda a cadeia de transporte.

Requisitos e qualificações
Desenvolvimento de Dashboards Estratégicos: Criação e manutenção de painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para monitoramento em tempo real de sinistralidade, performance de Gerenciadoras de Riscos e eficiência de transportadoras.
Análise Preditiva de Sinistralidade: Extração e tratamento de bases de dados para identificação de padrões de roubos e avarias, permitindo a antecipação de zonas de risco e otimização das rotas logísticas.
Auditoria Digital (PGR): Utilização de análise de dados para auditar a aderência aos Planos de Gerenciamento de Riscos, cruzando informações de rastreamento com as normas estabelecidas em apólice.
Gestão de KPIs de Operação e Segurança: Monitoramento técnico de metas de segurança, traduzindo dados complexos em relatórios executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão junto a seguradoras e alta gestão.
Automação e Otimização de Processos: Implementação de fluxos de dados para agilizar a regulação de sinistros e a comunicação entre transportadoras e seguradoras, reduzindo o tempo de resposta e erros manuais.
Domínio de Excel (Power Query e Pivot) / Desenvolvimento de dashboards / Gestão e tratamento de Dados.

title: Doutores inovando no setor empresarial - truck center - inovação em sistemas
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.
O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.
Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.
Sobre a Oportunidade:
A Truck Center é uma empresa paranaense com mais de 35 anos de atuação no desenvolvimento de equipamentos e softwares automotivos para alinhamento, balanceamento e serviços de pneus em veículos leves e pesados. Com forte foco em tecnologia, precisão e melhoria contínua, a empresa se destaca pelo compromisso com inovação e qualidade, oferecendo soluções completas que incluem fabricação, treinamento e suporte técnico. Diante disso, a Truck Center busca avançar em novos desafios, especialmente na criação de sistemas mais modernos e integrados para alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.
Projeto: Inovação em sistemas de alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.
Formação Acadêmica:
Doutorado completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Mecatrônica, Eletrônica, Física ou áreas correlatas.
Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.
Principais Atividades:
Testes funcionais dos equipamentos em oficina piloto;
Desenvolvimento sistema de calibração de câmeras automotivas;
Produção de manuais técnicos.
Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos
Visão sistêmica de P& D;
Conhecimento de ferramentas CAD/CAE Python, sistemas embarcados integração de sensores e sistemas.
Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Conhecimentos sobre under car, tanto da linha leve como da linha pesada, sistemas de alinhamento e geometria de veículos e balanceamento de rodas.
Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial
Formato de trabalho : Híbrido – Araucária/PR
(Integração presencial - após período de integração possibilidade de atuação híbrida)
Soft Skills : Liderança, Trabalho em equipe, Pensamento Crítico, Criatividade.
Oferecem refeição no local (café da manhã e almoço)

title: Purchasing agent - buyer
description:
Please note that the role requires Excellent communication skills in English (both written & oral).
Please share the resumes in English only.
BASIC PURPOSE: Support and expedite supply chain operations, process orders, and execute sourcing activities for orders. Manage all purchases for assigned vessels and processing on POs accordingly.
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Support operations for the purchasing process, primarily requisitioning and ordering.
Ensure all requisitions are compliant with the company’s policies.
Expedite inventory and direct charge purchase orders for multiple ships as required and in accordance with purchasing procedures.
Complete the processing of manual purchase orders.
Ensure all necessary approvals are documented, the orders are placed, and shipments are delivered on time.
Perform sourcing activities and get quotes on all items for POs for assigned vessels.
Ensure the items and prices are accurately listed in the PO.
Work with the sourcing team(s) and suppliers to get quotes on new items.
Ensure that all users, approvals, and filters are set up in accordance with the company’s procurement policies.
Serve as the help desk for users relating to the purchasing tools employed.
Coordinate processes with the accounts payable function to facilitate the enforcement of established policies.
Support implementation and management of ongoing operations for e Procurement solutions.
Regularly meet with the management to seek ongoing direction, coaching,and support as required.
Perform other job-related functions as assigned.
KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE:
EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in Business or other related field of study; or any equivalent combination of experience and skills.
EXPERIENCE: Minimum 1 year of experience with procurement operations, ERP (e.g. People Soft), e Procurement, e Catalog, contract management, e RFX, and e Auction strategies and technologies.
KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:
Good teamwork skills to work with other company departments to plan and execute enhancement, upgrade, and ongoing deployment of the above technologies.
Strong facilitation skills to communicate and collaborate with stakeholders across the company to implement Procure-to-Pay (P2 P) technologies.
Demonstrated success in gathering data, conducting analyses, and generating high-quality outputs.
Experience with process, quality control, and workflow management and design preferred. Numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to multi-task and problem solve.
An understanding of leading P2 P technology practices and trends (e.g. MXP, Amos, Ariba), general experience of network administration preferred.
Experience with ERP and P2 P systems (e.g. MXP, Amos, Ariba, People Soft), proficiency in Microsoft suite (Word, Excel, and Power Point).

title: Programa de formação de assessores de investimentos | contratação imediata + formação ancord
description:
Você quer ser Assessor de Investimentos, mas ainda não tem a ANCORD? Nós apostamos no seu talento.
Se o seu sonho é construir uma carreira de alta performance no mercado financeiro, mas você sente que as portas estão fechadas por falta de certificação ou experiência prática, o nosso Programa de Formação é o seu lugar.
Na Vértua, nós não buscamos apenas um currículo; buscamos dedicação, resiliência e vontade de crescer.
Como funciona a trilha do seu sucesso:
- Contratação Imediata: Você entra no time desde o dia 1.
- Formação ANCORD: Nós fornecemos o treinamento e o suporte para você conquistar a sua certificação ANCORD.
- A Escola de Vendas (SDR): Você iniciará como SDR (Sales Development Representative) para criar “casca”, dominar a abordagem a clientes e entender a psicologia do investidor.
- Aceleração de Ganhos: Ao bater suas metas, você dobra seu salário base. Sim, o seu esforço dita o seu ganho.
- Promoção a Assessor: Após a formação e o período de SDR, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes para atuar como Assessor de Investimentos.
O que buscamos em você:
- Foco em Pessoas: Você deve estar ciente de que o dia a dia exige conversar com pessoas.
- Fome de Crescimento: Queremos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e buscam o variável. 
- Goste de investimentos — você não precisa saber o que é um “CDB” hoje.
- Disponibilidade: Para atuação presencial em Cascavel.
O que oferecemos:
- Curso preparatório para ANCORD por conta da casa;
- Plano de Carreira Agressivo: Do SDR à Assessoria de Investimentos em tempo recorde;
- Cultura de Meritocracia: Dobra salarial por performance;
- Ambiente de Alto Nível: Networking com os melhores profissionais do mercado.
Como participar?
Se você tem brilho nos olhos e quer ser um dos grandes nomes do mercado financeiro, Candidate-se agora!

title: Compensation & benefits manager
description:
ABOUT COTY
Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.
Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!
JOB OVERVIEW
As a Compensation & Benefits Manager, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing compensation and benefits programs, as well as leading the respective team, ensuring competitive structures that attract, retain, and engage top talent. You will act proactively and strategically in the design and implementation of solutions, ensuring process optimization, governance, clarity, and effective communication with leaders, HRBPs, and employees. You will ensure that compensation structures and benefits packages are aligned with the organization’s strategic objectives and market best practices.
RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and implement global compensation strategies and processes that drive performance and talent retention;
Conduct compensation benchmarking analyses, ensuring alignment with market practices and presenting results to the global team;
Partner with leadership to review, approve, and adjust salary structures as needed;
Develop policies, guidelines, and processes related to compensation and benefits;
Create communication and training materials for leaders, HRBPs, and employees regarding compensation and benefits practices;
Manage comprehensive benefits programs (healthcare, dental, wellbeing, and non-monetary benefits), including vendor and partner management;
Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of benefits programs, proposing improvements based on business needs;
Monitor and manage healthcare claims ratio (loss ratio), conducting monthly analyses and developing preventive and corrective actions in partnership with the health area to optimize costs and support contractual negotiations;
Ensure compliance of compensation and benefits programs with labor laws and local regulations;
Maintain up-to-date compensation and benefits records and prepare reports for internal and external audits;
Manage and control all personnel costs, including annual budget preparation, forecasting, monthly reporting in business review meetings, efficiency initiatives, labor capitalization, and provisions control;
Act as an interface with different areas inside and outside HR to ensure budget execution aligned with planning;
Ensure smooth, secure, and transparent information flow with leadership, the team, and HRBPs.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or related fields;
Solid experience in compensation and benefits management within a corporate environment;
Previous experience leading teams;
In-depth knowledge of compensation and benefits practices and regulations;
Strong analytical skills, with experience in data management, budgeting, and process design;
Excellent communication, influence, and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders;
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and systemic thinking;
Availability to work in a hybrid model (2 days per week on-site);
Advanced English (mandatory);
Advanced Spanish (preferred);
High energy, ownership mindset, and transformation-oriented approach.

title: Senior developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Developer
Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day? Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location. It is necessary to live near the city.
Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?
In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients.
You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code.
To thrive in this development career, you'll need to have the following skills:
Front-End: HTML5, CSS, Java Script, Type Script, Angular, Stencil, Rx JS, Flutter (bonus) Back-End : Node.js, Express/Fastify, REST/Graph QL Data/Storage : Mongo DB, SQL, Redis, S3 Cloud/Dev Ops : AWS ECS, Lambda, CDN/Cloud Front, Git, Jenkins, Docker

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:
You'll have a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
Advanced English
Knowledge on payroll and/or accounting processes is desirable to understand what’s being done and how your work affects the users. Like our best developers, you are an enthusiastic creator eager to learn and take on stretch assignments. You strive to learn new technologies and find ways to incorporate what you learn into building your products.
As a Senior Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

WHAT YOU'LL DO: Here's what you can expect on a typical day:
You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to a large group of stakeholders.
Working in there-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Most of your daily schedule will be software development, but you will also test your code before submitting it to QA for final testing. You won't just focus on development in this role. You will also be responsible for testing and deployment.
You will attend meetings to actively collaborate with other developers to share ideas or show what you've learned. An eagerness to learn will help you keep up with ever-changing technologies and maintain the ability to create the best tools for our clients.
You're working on products currently in use. Those who report to you will act as a point of contact for one day/week, supporting your clients for any urgent issues requiring resolution. You may also have this responsibility. If so, you'll start those days with your regular work activity but will have to switch gears to a support role as needed throughout your assigned support day.
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN: Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution. Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity. Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes. Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft. Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation. Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.
Like what you see? Apply now!
*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até três vezes na semana.
"Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador"

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Analista de soluções - rh digital

title: Técnico químico / colorista
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Sherwin-Williams é uma empresa multinacional líder no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países e 80 anos de história no Brasil, nosso compromisso é oferecer as melhores soluções em tintas para as mais diversas finalidades, atendendo às necessidades de nossos clientes com qualidade e inovação.

Sobre o Papel

Estamos em busca de um Técnico Químico I cujas principais serão responsável por realizar o desenvolvimento, ajuste e controle de cores em tintas automotivas e industriais, com ênfase em sólidas (monocromáticas), perolizadas e metálicas. Atuará diretamente no laboratório de desenvolvimento, criando formulações, garantindo reprodutibilidade e suportando áreas como P& D, Qualidade e Produção. Local de atuação: Sumaré / São Paulo.

Responsabilidades

Desenvolver novas cores sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas conforme demandas de clientes, tendências de mercado ou projetos internos.
Ajustar tonalidade, flop, brilho e efeitos especiais utilizando pigmentos metálicos e perolizados.
Realizar correções de cor utilizando espectrofotômetro, software colorimétrico e cabine de luz.
Executar testes físico-químicos: viscosidade, brilho, aderência, resistência, densidade, entre outros.
Avaliar curvas de cor, diferença ΔE, metálicos e flop no espectrofotômetro.
Emitir relatórios técnicos e fichas de formulação.
Registrar ajustes, histórico de lotes e parâmetros críticos do processo.
Suportar o time de produção em ajustes de tonalidade em escala industrial.
Colaborar com Engenharia, Qualidade e Vendas em projetos especiais e atendimento ao cliente.
Qualificações
Conhecimentos Essenciais Experiência comprovada em tintas sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas (automotivas, industriais ou repintura).
Domínio de espectrofotômetro e softwares colorimétricos (ex.: Datacolor, X-Rite).
Conhecimento em pigmentação, dispersão e comportamento de flake metálico e mica perolizada.
Leitura e interpretação de curvas de cor e parâmetros Lab*.
Diferenciais
Experiência em laboratório de P& D.
Conhecimento em colorimetria avançada e ajustes complexos (high flop, alto brilho, efeitos especiais).
Formação Acadêmica

Técnico em Química (obrigatório).
Superior em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
CRQ ativo.
Experiência Mínima
2 a 5 anos em laboratório de tintas, preferencialmente com foco em cores especiais (metálicas e perolizadas).

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Gerente de serviços - husqvarna construção
description:
Olá, somos o Grupo Husqvarna, o maior produtor mundial de produtos de energia ao ar livre para Floresta & Jardim e Construção. Seu papel será liderar o time de serviços técnicos, garantindo excelência em reparos, suporte, treinamentos e melhoria contínua dos processos que sustentam nossa operação de pós-venda na Divisão de Construção.
